Slaton Dr, south leg (NB approach = forward direction). OSM: lanes=2 total, split guessed by netconvert (1 NB lane). GDOT's configuration has three NB stop-bar zones: Left (13709, P3), Thru (13732, P8) and Right (13731, P8). ASSUMPTION 2026-11-16: one lane per zone at the stop line, applied to the whole 333 m way (the real widening is probably a short bay), so NB storage is overstated; not verified on aerial imagery.

GDOT's configuration has three SB stop-bar zones: Left (13729, P7), Thru (13712, P4) and Right (13711, P4). ASSUMPTION 2026-11-16: one lane per zone, applied to the whole way; not verified on aerial imagery.
